newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu ends flat at 9,100/9,100.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu ends flat at 9,100/9,100.

text.p: The leu ended unchanged on Tuesday with quotes displayed by dealers ranging from 8,750/8,900 to 9,000/9,100, the same as its opening levels.

Traders said trading on the interbank market had been more liquid following moves by several big commercial banks to inject "some" hard currency to get lei funds which they needed to meet outstanding payments before the end of the month.

Latest central bank (BNR) data showed interbank trading amounted to $3.76 million on Monday, when overall trading stood at $20.99 million. This compared with a daily average of some $609,000 on interbank trading in January.
Retail rates hovered around 8,250/8,600 to the dollar.
* The money market operated mostly with overnight rates which amounted to some 305 percent, dealers said.
